unit: MES cells; one generated English cell contains up to two characters

main_dialogue.format: word-wrap and pad to the inferred lower-window runtime stride

dialogue_continuation.source: SCN 0x21 first text ID when the second ID is zero
dialogue_continuation.format: word-wrap and pad to the inferred continuation stride

side_thought.source: SCN 0x24/0x27 initial text ID and immediate standalone 0x27 continuation IDs
side_thought.format: word-wrap to the command's encoded floating-window width

overlay_text.source: SCN 0x24/0x28 initial text ID and immediate standalone 0x27 continuation IDs
overlay_text.format: word-wrap to the command or reviewed override

narration.source: reviewed record override for a distinct narration renderer
narration.format: word-wrap and enforce the reviewed row limit

menu_choice.source: SCN 0x31 text ID with a valid branch target
menu_choice.format: one normalized line; never merge with dialogue wrapping

safety_rules: Japanese MES and SCN files are read-only inputs
record IDs and order are never inferred from English text
formatting collapses whitespace only and must reconstruct the same words
words may not be split unless one word is wider than the complete box
floating and narration windows may not exceed their SCN-derived row limits
every SCN-classified translated record must use adaptive canonical layout
every translated record without proven reflow geometry must declare fixed layout
records with no proven role retain their explicit rendering
